description: Free-first web search MCP with zero-key English and Chinese sources and compact evidence.
name: io.github.lennney/agent-search-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Brave Search API key (optional, enables Brave engine)
environmentVariables.name: BRAVE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Tavily Search API key (optional, enables Tavily engine)
environmentVariables.name: TAVILY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Exa Search API key (optional, enables Exa engine)
environmentVariables.name: EXA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: You.com Search API key (optional, enables You.com engine)
environmentVariables.name: YDC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Tencent Web Search API key (optional, enables Tencent WSA engine)
environmentVariables.name: TENCENT_WSA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Bocha Web Search API key (optional, enables Bocha engine)
environmentVariables.name: BOCHA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Serper API key (optional, enables Google SERP search)
environmentVariables.name: SERPER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Provider policy: free_first, quality_escalation, paid_first, or free_only
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_PROVIDER_MODE
